draft.name: Chicken Stir-Fry
draft.description: Quick and delicious stir-fried chicken with vegetables and a savory sauce.
steps: Heat vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat until it shimmers.
Add chicken pieces and cook until golden and cooked through, about 6-8 minutes. Remove and set aside.
Add more oil if needed, then stir-fry garlic and ginger for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add onion and bell peppers, stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened.
Add broccoli and snap peas, continue stir-frying for 3-4 minutes.
Mix water and cornstarch together in a small bowl to create a slurry.
Return chicken to the wok and add soy sauce, oyster sauce, and sesame oil.
Pour in the cornstarch mixture and stir constantly for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Garnish with green onions and sesame seeds before serving.
Serve hot over steamed rice or noodles.

draft.name: Spaghetti Bolognese
draft.description: Classic Italian pasta with rich meat sauce and tomatoes.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion, carrot, and celery, and sauté for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced garlic and tomato paste, cooking for 2 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up as it cooks, about 8 minutes.
Pour in canned tomatoes and beef broth, add bay leaf and oregano.
Simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Cook spaghetti in salted boiling water until al dente, about 9 minutes.
Drain pasta and divide among plates.
Spoon sauce over pasta and serve immediately.

draft.name: Butternut Squash Soup
draft.description: A creamy, smooth soup made from roasted butternut squash with warm spices and a touch of cream.
steps: Heat olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add diced onion and cook for 5 minutes until softened.
Stir in minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add cubed butternut squash and vegetable stock to the pot.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes until squash is very tender.
Blend the soup until smooth using an immersion blender or by carefully transferring to a blender in batches.
Stir in heavy cream and season with salt, pepper, and nutmeg.
Add fresh or dried thyme and simmer for 5 more minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot with crusty bread or a dollop of sour cream if desired.

draft.name: Banana Bread
draft.description: A moist and tender loaf cake made with ripe bananas, perfect for breakfast or a sweet snack.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C (350°F) and grease a loaf tin.
Cream together the softened butter and sugar until light and fluffy, about 2-3 minutes.
Beat in the eggs one at a time, then add the vanilla extract.
In a separate bowl, combine the flour, baking soda, and salt.
Mash the ripe bananas until mostly smooth, leaving some small chunks for texture.
Fold the mashed bananas and dry ingredients alternately into the butter mixture, starting and ending with the dry ingredients.
Add the milk and gently mix until just combined; do not overmix.
Pour the batter into the prepared loaf tin and smooth the top.
Bake for 50-60 minutes, until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with just a few moist crumbs.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely before slicing.

draft.name: Pancakes
draft.description: Fluffy American-style pancakes, perfect for breakfast or brunch.
steps: In a large bowl, combine flour, sugar, baking powder and salt.
In another bowl, whisk together milk, eggs and melted butter.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir until just combined; the batter should be lumpy.
Heat a griddle or non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat and lightly oil it.
Pour about 60 ml of batter onto the griddle for each pancake, spacing them apart.
Cook for 2-3 minutes until the edges look set and bubbles form on top.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Transfer to a plate and repeat with remaining batter.
Serve warm with your choice of toppings.

draft.name: Baked Salmon with Lemon
draft.description: A quick and simple baked salmon fillet with bright lemon flavor, ready in under 20 minutes.
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C (400°F).
Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towels and place on a lined baking sheet.
Drizzle salmon with olive oil and season with salt and pepper.
Scatter minced garlic over the fillets and top with lemon slices.
Bake for 12-15 minutes until the salmon is cooked through and flakes easily with a fork.
Garnish with fresh dill if desired and serve immediately with any pan juices.

draft.name: 番茄炒蛋
draft.description: 清淡爽口的经典家常菜，番茄的酸味与鸡蛋的鲜香完美搭配。
steps: 将鸡蛋打入碗中，加入少许盐，用筷子打匀。
番茄洗净，用刀切成块状。
热锅下油，油热后倒入蛋液，炒至半熟时盛出备用。
锅中再加少许油，放入番茄块翻炒，使番茄出汁。
加入炒好的鸡蛋，轻轻翻炒，避免蛋块过碎。
加入糖和盐，继续炒匀，让番茄汁均匀分布。
撒上葱段，炒香后即可出锅。

draft.name: 麻婆豆腐
draft.description: 软嫩豆腐配上麻辣鲜香的肉末酱汁，是经典川菜。
steps: 在碗中混合淀粉和水制作芡汁，备用。
锅中热油，放入猪肉末炒至变色，盛出备用。
原锅再加油，放入姜末和蒜末炒香。
加入豆瓣酱翻炒均匀，炒出香味。
倒入清汤或水，加入生抽和糖烧开。
轻轻放入豆腐块，用勺子轻轻搅拌避免豆腐碎裂，煮3-5分钟。
将炒好的肉末倒回锅中混合。
撒上花椒粉和辣椒粉（根据口味调整），轻轻搅拌。
倒入芡汁，边倒边搅拌，使汤汁浓稠。
关火前撒上葱段，盛盘即可享用。

draft.name: 红烧肉
draft.description: 软烂入味的传统红烧肉，用高压锅快速烹制，色香味俱佳。
steps: 猪五花肉洗净，切成3厘米见方的块，冷水下锅煮沸后撇去浮沫，沥干备用。
高压锅底部放油烧热，下冰糖炒至焦黄，加入肉块快速翻炒至表面焦香。
倒入生抽、老抽和料酒，翻炒均匀使肉块上色。
加入姜片、葱段、八角、桂皮、香叶和花椒，翻炒出香味。
倒入清水，水量以没过肉块5厘米为宜。
盖上高压锅盖，大火烧至冒蒸汽后，转中火压35分钟。
自然放气10分钟后，缓缓打开锅盖。
打开高压锅后，转普通锅，用大火收汁5-10分钟至汤汁浓稠即可上桌。

draft.name: 猪肉白菜饺子
draft.description: 鲜香多汁的传统猪肉白菜馅饺子，皮薄馅丰富。
steps: 面粉加入一半的水和盐，边加边混合，逐次加入剩余的水，揉至光滑面团，静置30分钟。
白菜切碎后用盐腌制10分钟，然后挤干水分。
将猪肉馅、白菜、葱、生姜、酱油、香油、食用油和黑胡椒粉混合，搅拌均匀至起胶状。
面团分成40个小剂子，每个约15克，擀成圆形饺子皮。
在饺子皮中心放入约10克馅料，对折后捏紧边缘，做成半月形或褶皱形。
大锅烧水至沸腾，放入饺子，用勺子轻轻推动以防粘底。
水再次沸腾后加入半碗冷水，继续煮至饺子浮起，重复加冷水过程共3次。
饺子全部浮起且饺子皮呈透明状即可用漏勺捞出。
装盘，配以醋、酱油或辣油等调料蘸食。

draft.name: 葱油拌面
draft.description: 简单快手的中式面食，用香葱和油香味道拌匀面条。
steps: 将面条放入沸水中煮至熟透，约8-10分钟，然后沥干。
葱段切成2厘米长的段，放入碗中。
在小锅中加热植物油至起烟，然后慢慢倒在葱段上，使其香味充分释放。
在碗中混合酱油、糖、盐和黑胡椒粉。
将沥干的面条放入葱油碗中，与葱油和调料充分混合。
盛碗时铲起面条底部的葱油，使每口面条都均匀受味。

draft.name: 玉米排骨汤
draft.description: 清甜营养的玉米排骨汤，适合全家享用。
steps: 将猪排骨洗净，用热水焯一下去除血沫，冲洗干净沥干。
玉米切成5厘米长的段，红萝卜切成滚刀块备用。
砂锅加入清水，放入生姜片烧热。
放入焯好的排骨，转中火煲30分钟。
加入玉米段、红萝卜块、红枣和蜜枣，继续煲20分钟。
尝味道，根据需要加盐调味即可。
盛碗时可去掉姜片，享用温热的玉米排骨汤。

draft.name: Kung Pao Chicken
draft.description: Spicy stir-fried chicken with cashews, bell peppers, and a savory-sweet sauce.
steps: Toss diced chicken with cornstarch and a pinch of salt to coat evenly.
Heat vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over high heat until shimmering.
Add chicken and stir-fry until cooked through and lightly browned, about 5-7 minutes. Remove and set aside.
In the same pan, add more oil if needed and stir-fry dried chili peppers, garlic, and ginger for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add diced bell pepper and onion, stir-fry for 2-3 minutes until slightly softened.
Mix soy sauce, rice vinegar, sugar, sesame oil, and water in a small bowl.
Return chicken to the pan and pour in the sauce mixture. Stir well to coat everything.
Add cashews and toss everything together for 1-2 minutes until the sauce thickens and coats the ingredients.
Garnish with sliced green onion and serve immediately with steamed rice.

draft.name: Fried Rice
draft.description: A quick and delicious way to use leftover rice with vegetables, eggs, and soy sauce.
steps: Heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat.
Scramble the eggs until cooked through, then remove and set aside.
Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the onion and garlic for about 1 minute until fragrant.
Add the diced carrot and peas, cooking for 2-3 minutes until tender.
Break up the cold rice and add it to the pan, stirring constantly to separate grains and combine with vegetables.
Return the scrambled eggs to the pan and mix well.
Pour in the soy sauce and sesame oil, tossing everything together for 1-2 minutes.
Season with salt and white pepper to taste.
Transfer to a serving dish and garnish with fresh green onions.
Serve hot.

draft.name: Simple Weekend Breakfast
draft.description: A satisfying homemade breakfast with scrambled eggs, toast, and fresh fruit to start your weekend right.
steps: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk together with milk, salt, and pepper.
Heat butter in a non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan and stir gently until scrambled and cooked through, about 3-4 minutes.
Toast the bread until golden brown.
Spread butter on the warm toast if desired.
Arrange the scrambled eggs and toast on plates.
Serve with fresh berries on the side.
Enjoy your weekend breakfast!

draft.name: Simple Vegetable Stir-Fry
draft.description: A quick and colorful stir-fried medley of fresh vegetables with garlic and soy sauce.
steps: Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add minced garlic and ginger, stirring for about 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the harder vegetables first: carrots and broccoli, stir-frying for 2-3 minutes.
Add bell pepper, mushrooms, and snap peas, continuing to stir-fry for another 2-3 minutes until vegetables are tender-crisp.
In a small bowl, whisk together soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil.
Pour the sauce over the vegetables and toss well to coat, cooking for another 1 minute.
Season with salt and black pepper to taste, then serve immediately over rice or noodles.

draft.name: Chicken stir-fry
draft.description: A quick, savory chicken and vegetable stir-fry.
steps: Toss the sliced chicken with soy sauce and cornstarch; let it sit for 10 minutes.
Heat the vegetable oil in a wok or large pan over high heat.
Add the chicken and stir-fry until golden and cooked through, then transfer to a plate.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and stir-fry for 30 seconds until fragrant.
Add the broccoli, bell pepper and carrot and stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes until crisp-tender.
Return the chicken to the pan, drizzle with sesame oil and season with salt to taste.
Toss everything together and serve hot.

draft.name: Spaghetti bolognese
draft.description: A rich tomato and beef sauce tossed with spaghetti, made with minimal added salt.
steps: Warm the olive oil in a wide pan over medium heat.
Cook the onion, carrot and celery for 8 to 10 minutes until soft.
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more.
Add the minced beef and break it up, cooking until it loses its raw colour.
Stir in the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Pour in the chopped tomatoes, add the oregano and a few grinds of pepper, then simmer gently for 25 to 30 minutes.
While the sauce simmers, cook the spaghetti in plenty of boiling water until al dente, then drain.
Taste the sauce and add only a little salt if it needs it.
Toss the spaghetti with the sauce and scatter over the torn basil.

draft.name: Butternut squash soup
draft.description: A creamy vegetarian butternut squash soup.
steps: Heat the olive oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the onion, carrot and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the cubed butternut squash and stir to coat.
Pour in the vegetable stock and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat and simmer until the squash is tender, about 20 minutes.
Blend the soup until smooth with an immersion blender or in batches in a blender.
Season with salt, pepper and a pinch of nutmeg.
Serve hot.

draft.name: Banana bread
draft.description: A moist, lightly sweet loaf made with ripe bananas.
steps: Heat the oven to 175 C and line a loaf tin.
Mash the bananas in a large bowl, then stir in the melted butter.
Mix in the sugar, beaten egg and vanilla extract until smooth.
Add the flour, baking soda and salt, and fold just until no dry flour remains.
Pour the batter into the lined tin and smooth the top.
Bake for 55 to 65 minutes, until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean.
Cool in the tin for 10 minutes, then turn out onto a rack to cool fully.

draft.name: Pancakes
draft.description: Fluffy homemade pancakes, perfect for a weekend breakfast.
steps: In a large bowl, whisk together flour, baking powder, sugar and salt.
In another bowl, whisk eggs, milk and melted butter until combined.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir until just combined; a few lumps are fine.
Heat a lightly greased pan over medium heat.
Pour about 60 ml of batter per pancake into the pan.
Cook until bubbles form on the surface and the edges look set, about 2-3 minutes.
Flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining batter, greasing the pan as needed.
Serve warm with your favorite toppings.

draft.name: Baked salmon with lemon
draft.description: A quick, simple baked salmon fillet brightened with fresh lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C and line a baking tray with parchment.
Pat the salmon fillets dry and place them on the tray.
Drizzle with olive oil, then season with salt and black pepper.
Top each fillet with lemon slices.
Bake for 12 to 15 minutes until the salmon flakes easily.
Squeeze over the lemon juice, scatter with parsley and serve.

draft.name: 番茄炒蛋
draft.description: 一道快速简单的家常菜，酸甜开胃。
steps: 鸡蛋打散，加少许盐搅匀。
番茄洗净切块，葱切碎备用。
锅中倒入一半食用油，烧热后倒入蛋液，炒至刚凝固盛出。
锅中补入剩余食用油，放入番茄块中火翻炒至出汁。
加入白糖和盐调味，翻炒均匀。
倒回炒好的鸡蛋，快速翻炒使味道融合。
撒上葱花，关火出锅。

draft.name: 麻婆豆腐
draft.description: 家常版麻婆豆腐，辣度温和，麻香下饭。
steps: 豆腐块放入淡盐水中浸泡5分钟，捞出沥干。
锅中放油烧热，下猪肉末炒散至变色。
加入豆瓣酱、豆豉、姜末、蒜末，小火炒出红油和香味。
倒入清水和生抽，煮开后放入豆腐块，轻轻推匀，中小火煮3分钟。
分两次淋入水淀粉勾芡，轻推使汤汁浓稠。
撒入花椒粉、青蒜段，尝味后按需加盐，出锅即可。

draft.description: 家常水饺，皮薄馅大，约40个。
steps: 面粉加清水揉成光滑面团，盖湿布醒30分钟。
大白菜切碎，加少许盐腌10分钟，挤干水分备用。
猪肉末加葱末、姜末、生抽、蚝油、香油、白胡椒粉和盐，顺一个方向搅打上劲。
加入白菜碎和食用油，拌匀成饺子馅。
面团搓条切剂，按扁擀成中间厚边缘薄的饺子皮。

draft.name: 葱油拌面
draft.description: 一碗香气扑鼻的葱油拌面，简单又美味。
steps: 小葱洗净切段，葱白和葱绿分开。
锅中倒入食用油，冷油放入葱白，小火慢炸至微黄。
加入葱绿继续小火炸至葱段变焦黄，关火捞出葱段。

将煮好的面条放入碗中，淋上葱油酱汁，拌匀即可。

draft.name: 玉米排骨汤
draft.description: 清甜温和的家常汤，排骨软嫩、玉米香甜，适合给孩子喝。
steps: 排骨冷水下锅，煮开后撇去浮沫，捞出用温水冲净。
把排骨、姜片和清水放入汤锅，大火煮开后转小火炖40分钟。
加入玉米段和胡萝卜块，继续小火炖25分钟至食材软烂。
关火前加少许盐调味，搅匀后稍微放温再给孩子喝。

draft.name: Kung Pao chicken 宫保鸡丁
draft.description: A spicy Sichuan stir-fry of diced chicken with dried chillies and a savoury-sweet sauce, made without peanuts.

Heat the oil in a wok over a high flame, add the chicken in a single layer and fry until golden at the edges, then remove.
Add the chillies and Sichuan peppercorns to the wok and stir for a few seconds until fragrant but not burnt.
Add the garlic and ginger and stir-fry for 20 seconds.
Return the chicken to the wok, pour in the sauce and toss over high heat until it thickens and coats everything.
Stir in the spring onions and check the seasoning, adding salt only if needed.
Serve straight away with steamed rice.

draft.name: Leftover rice stir-fry
draft.description: A quick and versatile way to turn cold cooked rice into a satisfying meal.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat.
Pour in the beaten eggs and scramble until just set, then transfer to a plate.
Add the remaining oil, then stir-fry the carrot and peas for 2 minutes.
Add the cold rice and break up any clumps with a spatula, frying for 3-4 minutes.
